description: Per-minute clicks and currency-converted spend for CPC-strategy PLA campaigns on a single local day, split by campaign (marketing campaign id) and page_type (raw page_type; SEARCH vs NON-SEARCH is derived in the Python layer). Each row is one local minute of one campaign+page_type: local minute timestamp, hour, and minute, plus valid clicks and spend (bid converted USD -> marketplace currency). Requires a campaign_id filter; the single day is set by the start/end date (same date). Timezone-aware: the minute/date casts use __SP_TIMEZONE__.

campaign_id.description: The marketing campaign id (campaign_tagging_data.marketing_campaign_id) resolved from the internal click campaign_id. MANDATORY per-call filter used to scope the report to specific campaign(s).

hour.selector: SAFE_CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CAST(DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(c.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') AS DATETIME)) AS STRING)

minute.selector: SAFE_CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM CAST(DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(c.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') AS DATETIME)) AS STRING)

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(c.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN c.unique_click ELSE 0 END), 0)

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(c.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN COALESCE(c.bid, 0) * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Click spend in this local minute (click bid) converted from USD to the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_product_ads_response_to_clicks_mapping AS c JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON c.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id LEFT JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency JOIN reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd ON SAFE_CAST(c.campaign_id AS STRING) = ctd.campaign_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND c.is_valid_click = TRUE AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(c.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND c.click_timestamp_utc >= DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '__START_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND c.click_timestamp_utc < DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '__END_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
